kauai.flightText: American: AA PHL-LAX/PHX-LIH, 1 stop. Other option: JFK-HNL nonstop + hop to LIH, ~$900 + ~$90

itinerary.title: Arrive + Poipu Beach
itinerary.plan: Land LIH, pick up SUV, 30 min to Poipu, sunset at Poipu Beach Park.
itinerary.eat: Fish tacos at Da Crack, Koloa

itinerary.title: Waimea Canyon
itinerary.plan: Drive up Waimea Canyon to Kalalau Lookout; stop in Waimea town on the way back.

itinerary.title: Na Pali by boat
itinerary.plan: Morning catamaran from Port Allen along Na Pali sea caves; snorkel if calm.

itinerary.title: North Shore + Hanalei
itinerary.plan: Kilauea Point lighthouse, Hanalei Bay pier, Tunnels/Haena views (Haena park needs reservation).

itinerary.title: Wailua River
itinerary.plan: Guided Wailua River kayak to Secret Falls or boat to Fern Grotto; Wailua Falls overlook.

itinerary.title: South shore slow day
itinerary.plan: Mahaulepu coastal walk, Spouting Horn, Allerton or McBryde garden tour, Koloa town.

itinerary.title: Fly home
itinerary.plan: Beach morning, return SUV at LIH, fly home.

oahu-maui.name: Oahu + Maui combo, Hawaii
oahu-maui.tagline: Two islands: Waikiki history, Maui scenery
oahu-maui.whyParents: Best of both: Pearl Harbor and Waikiki, then Haleakala sunrise and Road to Hana.
oahu-maui.stay: Waikiki condo 3 nights, then Kihei condo 3 nights
oahu-maui.getAround: Oahu: walk/Uber, 1-day car. Maui: full-size SUV or minivan for 4 adults + bags.
oahu-maui.entry: US domestic: no passport. REAL ID or passport for TSA.
events: Honolulu Marathon: Sun Dec 13 2026; Waikiki road closures early morning
Honolulu City Lights at Honolulu Hale (opened Dec 5 2026)
Lahaina Front Street scheduled reopening Aug 1 2026; harbor dredging through Dec 2026
Humpback whale season starting on Maui
pros: Two very different islands in a week
unverified: No live Dec 12-18 2026 fares seen; AA fares are estimates from aa.com route-page snapshots (PHL-HNL round trip from $658, other months).
No American nonstop PHL-HNL found in any airline/airport source; AA hubs to Hawaii (DFW, PHX, LAX, ORD) are the realistic connections.
Hawaiian/Alaska JFK-HNL nonstop (HA/AS 830) seen only on schedule aggregators for spring 2026; December 2026 operation not confirmed.
Lodging and rental car prices are estimates from 2025-26 listing snapshots and HTA averages, not live Dec 2026 quotes.
Weather figures are typical December climate, not a forecast.
Open-jaw AA pricing not seen; interisland fare snapshot is from summer 2026 dates
oahu-maui.precip: mostly sunny leeward sides, passing showers; Haleakala summit near freezing at dawn
oahu-maui.flightText: Hawaiian or Delta out, American home: Hawaiian/Delta JFK-HNL nonstop; OGG-PHX/DFW-PHL on AA home. Other option: All AA 1-stop from PHL (in HNL, out OGG) ~$920 incl. hop

itinerary.title: Arrive Waikiki
itinerary.plan: Land HNL, check in Waikiki, sunset beach walk.

itinerary.title: Pearl Harbor + Diamond Head
itinerary.plan: USS Arizona Memorial timed tickets; afternoon Diamond Head hike (reserved slot).

itinerary.title: North Shore
itinerary.plan: Rental car day: Haleiwa, Waimea Bay surf, turtles at Laniakea, Kualoa views.

itinerary.title: Fly to Maui
itinerary.plan: Morning hop HNL-OGG, pick up SUV, Kihei condo, Kamaole beach sunset.

itinerary.title: Haleakala sunrise
itinerary.plan: Sunrise reservation, short crater walk, Kula farms and lunch.

itinerary.title: Road to Hana
itinerary.plan: Early start: waterfalls, Waianapanapa black sand (reservation), Wailua Falls; back before dark.

itinerary.title: Fly home
itinerary.plan: Paia breakfast, Hookipa turtles, return SUV, fly OGG.

_recs.paris-alsace: Paris, which Mom and Dad love, plus Strasbourg and Colmar at the height of Christmas market season. American flies nonstop from Philly and fast trains do the rest, with no driving.
_recs.vienna-prague: Two of Europe's most beautiful Christmas market cities, linked by a 4 hour train. Nonstop out from Newark and a bit cheaper than Paris.
_recs.portugal: The easiest Europe week: mild 59°F days, American nonstop from Philly, and some of the best value food in Europe.
_recs.costa-rica: Warm, green and the lowest cost trip on the list: a 5.5 hour nonstop, then volcanoes, hot springs, sloths and Pacific beaches.
_recs.thailand: The Asia trip they are curious about: temples, night markets and 88°F days. Very cheap once there; the catch is about 22 hours of travel each way.
